summary: TELUS filed a 6-K attaching its Q3 2026 results release, which discloses an active divestiture process for non-core assets, with near-term priority on accelerating monetization of TELUS Health and TELUS Agriculture Consumer Goods; proceeds earmarked for debt reduction. No buyer, price, or stake was disclosed. The release records an $800 million pre-tax non-cash goodwill impairment at the TELUS Health cash-generating unit tied to updated growth expectations, market conditions, and the active divestiture process. A multi-year efficiency program targets ~$900 million annualized savings exiting 2028, alongside a stated 3.0x net-debt/EBITDA goal by 2028. Watch sale-process launch, buyer identity, and valuation marks against the impaired carrying value.
